# SculptClub

> SculptClub is a small private training studio in the Jordaan, Amsterdam (Egelantiersgracht 424, 1015 RR). Personal trainers and small groups rent it by the hour (half studio from €12, full studio from €17), people train on their own with Open Gym (max 4 people at a time), and independent personal trainers coach their clients there. Open every day 06:00–22:00. Book online, or ask by WhatsApp on +31 6 15 14 79 52.

## What SculptClub is

SculptClub is one private, fully equipped training room on a canal in the Jordaan, not a big gym. There is no reception and no membership needed. You book a time, you get a door code by WhatsApp at midnight before your session, and you let yourself in.

People use it in four ways:

1. **Rent the studio by the hour.** For freelance personal trainers, physiotherapists and coaches who bring their own clients. Half studio for 1-on-1 (max 2 people), full studio fully private for 1 to 8 people (your own small group). Trainers keep 100% of what they charge their clients; SculptClub only charges rent.
2. **Open Gym.** Train on your own, max 4 people in the studio at a time. Single session or a 4-week plan, cancel anytime.
3. **Personal training.** With one of the independent trainers who work from the studio. SCULPT TRANSFORMATION from €299 per 4 weeks, unlimited Open Gym included. The first intake is free.
4. **Small group training.** Train in a small group of 2 to 4 people with a coach.

Founded 2025. Rated 5.0 on Google.

## Where

- Address: Egelantiersgracht 424, 1015 RR Amsterdam, Netherlands (Jordaan)
- Coordinates: 52.3759967, 4.880676
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/SculptClub/@52.3759967,4.880676,17z
- Opening hours: every day 06:00–22:00

## How to book

- Rent the studio: https://sculptclub.nl/nl/studio-huren (EN: https://sculptclub.nl/en/studio-rental). Pick half or full studio and a time, pay online.
- First time renting? One free session with your own client: https://sculptclub.nl/nl/studio-huren/gratis-test (EN: https://sculptclub.nl/en/studio-rental/free-trial)
- Open Gym: https://sculptclub.nl/nl/open-gym (EN: https://sculptclub.nl/en/open-gym)
- Personal training: pick a trainer and plan a free intake at https://sculptclub.nl/nl/vind-jouw-personal-trainer (EN: https://sculptclub.nl/en/find-personal-trainer). Personal training is arranged directly with the trainer.
- Questions: WhatsApp https://wa.me/31615147952, phone +31 6 15 14 79 52, email contact@sculptclub.nl
- Door code: sent by WhatsApp at midnight before your session (Open Gym and studio rental). For personal training, your trainer arranges access.
- Cancelling is always free, with no time limit.
- Payment: credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay. Studio rental can also be paid by invoice, on request.
- No contracts. Open Gym runs in 4-week cycles and can be cancelled anytime.

## Prices

All prices include VAT.

Studio rental (per session):
- Half studio (1-on-1, max 2 people): €12 per 60 min, €17 per 90 min
- Full studio (private, 1 to 8 people): €17 per 60 min, €24 per 90 min
- Studio credit packs, valid 1 year: Starter €89 (€99 credit), Routine €179 (€210 credit), Pro €299 (€375 credit), Volume €499 (€650 credit)
- First session for a new trainer: free

Open Gym:
- Single session: €9 for 1 hour, no membership needed
- Instapplan: 4 sessions per 4 weeks, €29
- Onbeperkt (unlimited): €79 per 4 weeks. New members currently join at €49 per 4 weeks and keep that price for as long as they stay a member.
- Students (with student ID): unlimited for €39 per 4 weeks

Personal training:
- SCULPT TRANSFORMATION from €299 per 4 weeks, unlimited Open Gym included
- Trainers are self-employed and agree their price with you; the first intake is free

## The studio and equipment

- Power rack with Olympic barbell and platform, adjustable benches, cable machine
- Dumbbells from 4 to 40 kg
- Echo Bike, sled, kettlebells
- Showers and changing area
- Skylight and canal view; the room can also be rented as a photo or content studio: https://sculptclub.nl/nl/fotostudio-huren (EN: https://sculptclub.nl/en/photo-studio-rental)
